title: Fire Sub-Council Council Order No. 0015454: tank vehicles stored in a Group F Division 2 building (varied with conditions on an equivalent-safety finding)
jurisdiction: Alberta (order issued by an accredited municipality; the municipality is not named in the decision text)
code_edition: Alberta Fire Code 2014 (stated on p.1-3 and p.9-10)
document_date: 2015-12-03 (dated; Chair signature block; hearing 2015-11-06; order dated 2015-06-09)

facts.text: The accredited municipality issued an order dated 9 June 2015 against the president and general manager of an oil field service company, concerning tank vehicles stored in a building.

The order's requirements (quoted after 'FROM:') were to remove the tank vehicles from the building and to cease storing them there until Sentence 4.11.2.3.(1) of Division B of AFC 2014 is complied with.

The panel framed two issues: whether the building, classified as Medium Hazard Industrial Group F Division 2, breaches AFC 2014, and whether the Safety Codes Officer's order should be upheld or varied.
The panel recorded that circumstances had changed since the Safety Codes Officer first inspected the building in December 2014.
The panel found the appellant's revised practices sufficient to satisfy the objective or intent of AFC 2014.
The panel found that the current practices are an acceptable solution under AFC 2014 that satisfies the objective of an acceptable level of risk.

The panel found the Varied Order provides approximately equivalent or greater safety performance as provided for by the Safety Codes Act, and added the company's name to the order because the building is leased in that name.
The Council ordered that the Order is VARIED WITH CONDITIONS.
The decision is dated 3 December 2015 and carries a Chair signature block for the Appeal Panel.
